text.tspan: CLI: v2.1.0-pre-release.0 | cmd: socket manifest bazel | org: (not set) | token: (not set)
[beta] Bazel SBOM support — generate manifest files for a Bazel project (Maven, PyPI)
Usage
$ socket manifest bazel [options] [CWD=.]
Options
--bazel Path to bazel/bazelisk binary; default: $(which bazelisk) || $(which bazel)
--bazel-flags Bazel command flags, with quoted values and literal backslashes
--bazel-output-base Bazel --output_base for read-only-cache CI environments
--bazel-rc Path to additional .bazelrc fragments forwarded to bazel
--ecosystem Ecosystem(s) to extract; repeatable. Supported: maven, pypi. Default: maven.
--out Output directory for generated manifests; default: ./.socket/bazel-manifests/
--per-repo-timeout Per-hub bazel cquery timeout in milliseconds; default: 120000
--verbose Emit bounded Bazel diagnostics with argv, duration, exit status, and output sizes
[beta] Generates Bazel SBOM manifests for Maven (`maven_install.json`)
by running `bazel query` against discovered dependency repos.
PyPI requirements generation is available with `--ecosystem pypi`.
Output is consumed by
`socket scan create`'s server-side parser.
--ecosystem may be repeated to select which ecosystems to extract.
When omitted, Maven is generated by default. PyPI is explicit opt-in.
Note: this command generates dependency manifests for Bazel workspaces.
It does not run reachability analysis.
Native Windows support currently covers Maven. Use PowerShell or
Command Prompt with a working Python 3 python.exe and a JDK on PATH.
PyPI extraction on Windows is not supported yet.
Set SOCKET_BAZEL_OUTPUT_ROOT to a short, writable parent directory,
such as C:/sb, to shorten connector-owned Bazel output paths. Each
invocation gets a separate directory. An explicit --bazel-output-base
takes precedence for Bazel's cache and is kept after the scan. The
scan only stops Bazel servers it started.
In --bazel-flags, single or double quotes at the start of a value or
after = group values containing spaces. Backslashes stay literal. Double a matching quote to include
it within a quoted value. Shell variables are not expanded.
Maven hub discovery: under Bzlmod, hubs are enumerated from
`bazel mod show_extension` and filtered to the root module's own hubs.
Under legacy WORKSPACE mode (no `show_extension`), only conventionally
named hubs are probed (`maven`, `maven_install`, `maven_dev`, …). A hub
with a non-conventional name that `show_extension` does not enumerate is
not discovered yet; a flag to name extra hubs is planned.
To generate AND upload in one step, use `socket scan create --auto-manifest`
instead — it detects Bazel workspaces, generates Maven manifests by
default, and uploads the result. This subcommand is for generation only.
Examples
$ socket manifest bazel .
$ socket manifest bazel --ecosystem pypi .
$ socket manifest bazel --ecosystem maven --ecosystem pypi .
$ socket manifest bazel --bazel=/usr/local/bin/bazelisk .
